intro.step1: Talk like you normally would: “104 GI 2, calc 1. 105 missing. Tongue normal.”
intro.step2: Stay on any page. Each finding goes to the right place in the chart.
intro.step3: Tap Stop when you’re done. Anything it wasn’t sure about is listed under Needs review.

clinical.title: {{target}} dictation
clinical.help: Record or paste the clinician’s observations. Review the proposed sections before applying them. Undocumented findings stay blank.
clinical.ctHelp: Record or paste CT observations. When you stop, they are added only to the CT report and refined automatically.
clinical.noSections: No clinical sections were found. Your transcript is available for review.
clinical.stale: This visit or its source text changed. Prepare the sections again before applying.
clinical.applied: Selected sections applied to this visit.
clinical.savedWithVisit: The transcript is kept with this visit after you apply it. It is not included in printed reports.
clinical.copyPromptShown: The transcript is ready to copy from the dialog.
clinical.storageLimit: This visit has reached its transcript storage limit. Copy the transcript before closing.
clinical.invalidSource: The transcript source is invalid. Review the transcript and try again.
clinical.emptyTranscript: Record or paste a transcript first.
clinical.transcriptTooLong: The transcript is too long. Split it into smaller dictations and try again.
clinical.sourceTooLarge: There is too much source text for one request. Choose a narrower dictation target or shorten the transcript.
clinical.invalidResponse: The proposed sections could not be validated. Review the transcript and try again.
clinical.extractionFailed: Could not prepare the sections. Your transcript has been kept.
clinical.failed: Could not complete dictation. Your transcript has been kept.
clinical.consentRequired: AI consent is needed to record or prepare this dictation.
